subject.title: feat(discord): add canvas-first Discord Activities support

question: Should Discord Activity support be rebuilt behind the Canvas plugin contract with mandatory credentialed/verifiable Activity auth, or should maintainers explicitly accept this core-level Activity auth/config design?
rationale: The PR crosses plugin ownership, root config, gateway authentication, third-party browser code execution, and public WebSocket fanout boundaries; automation cannot choose that product/security contract for maintainers.

options.title: Rebuild behind Canvas plugin
options.body: Move Activity config/auth/bridge ownership into the Canvas plugin surface, keep Gateway auth fail-closed unless a strong Activity credential or signed assertion is present, bundle SDK assets, and bound fanout before merge.

options.title: Accept core Activity surface
options.body: Maintain the new root config and core Gateway bypass only if maintainers document the threat model, upgrade behavior, token transport, and SDK supply-chain acceptance explicitly.

options.title: Pause for replacement PR
options.body: Close or pause this conflicted branch and ask for a narrower fresh PR if the current branch is too far from current main's Canvas/plugin architecture.

recommendation.title: Rebuild behind Canvas plugin
recommendation.body: Move Activity config/auth/bridge ownership into the Canvas plugin surface, keep Gateway auth fail-closed unless a strong Activity credential or signed assertion is present, bundle SDK assets, and bound fanout before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Canvas plugin boundary and recent gateway auth-bypass surface both trace most directly to steipete's recent mainline work.
